helpIntro: Pitt uses a 4.0 scale with A+ and A both worth 4.00. Enter Pitt credits and final grades to estimate your current or cumulative GPA, then plan future courses or a target GPA.
helpNote: S/NC, H/S/U, audit, withdrawal, and unfinished grades carry no quality points. For repeats, Pitt uses the most recent graded attempt; the simple Repeat Impact tool models one same-credit replacement only.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12 quality points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.75. Together, 21.75 ÷ 6 = 3.625.

gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.00 quality points; its credits count in the GPA denominator.
gradeExplanations.H: Honors grade under H/S/U; no quality points and excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.S: Satisfactory grade; may earn credit but is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory under H/S/U; no quality points and excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.G: Unfinished ongoing coursework; excluded until a final grade is recorded.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete due to the nature of the course; excluded pending completion.
gradeExplanations.NG: Lapsed unfinished coursework; no quality points.
gradeExplanations.M: Military duty notation; no quality points.
gradeExplanations.N: Audit; no quality points, graduation credit, or GPA impact.
gradeExplanations.R: Resigned from term; no quality points.
gradeExplanations.Z: Invalid grade submitted; unresolved and carries no quality points.
gradeExplanations.**: No grade reported; unresolved and carries no quality points.

specialTypes.note: Use the official Pitt grade on the career-level academic record.

specialTypes.name: External transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Accepted transfer units may apply to degree requirements but external grades are not entered as Pitt letter-grade GPA rows.

specialTypes.name: School of Medicine or other special grading context
specialTypes.note: Professional and program-specific grading or GPA requirements need the applicable school policy.

repeatPolicy.note: For a simple graded repeat, the most recent graded attempt replaces the prior grade in GPA even if it is lower. The calculator estimates one same-credit replacement; verify eligibility and multi-attempt cases with the Registrar.
